title: Sprint 14 Engineering Kickoff
transcript:
Marcus: Standup time. Coffee machine is fixed.
Priya: Regarding the mobile nav bug, I will fix the navigation drawer overlap on iOS by Friday.
Alex Chen: I'll optimize the Postgres database connection pooling and deploy it to staging tomorrow.
Sarah: We should probably look into upgrading our Kubernetes clusters next quarter.
Marcus: Yeah, let's keep that in mind for Q4 roadmap, no action for now.
negative_phrases: upgrading our Kubernetes clusters next quarter

title: Acme Corp Client Sync
transcript:
Marcus: Thanks for joining Acme Corp sync.
Client Rep: We noticed our invoice exports are missing the VAT tax breakdown.
Alex Chen: I'll update the PDF generator to include the VAT tax breakdown line by next Monday.
Client Rep: That would be fantastic. Also, do you think AI autofill is something we could do later this year?
Marcus: It is definitely on our radar, but nothing committed yet.
Sarah: I will set up the automated Datadog alerts for client invoice failures today.
negative_phrases: AI autofill is something we could do later this year

title: Incident INC-492 Postmortem
transcript:
Marcus: Postmortem for incident INC-492 database saturation.
Sarah: I will increase the RDS read replica provisioned IOPS by tomorrow.
Alex Chen: I'll add rate limiting on the public API search endpoint by Friday.
Priya: Maybe we could refactor the entire frontend search component someday.
Marcus: Let's focus on the P0 stability items first.
Sarah: Understood. I'll document the failover playbook in Notion by end of week.
negative_phrases: refactor the entire frontend search component someday

title: Weak Commitment & Look-into-it Test
transcript:
Marcus: Did anyone check why customer onboarding drop-off increased?
Alex Chen: I'll look into the onboarding analytics funnel by tomorrow EOD.
Priya: We should probably overhaul the welcome email sequence eventually.
Marcus: Let's hold off on emails until Alex finishes the funnel check.
negative_phrases: overhaul the welcome email sequence eventually

title: Non-Commitment Filter Test
transcript:
Marcus: Any general thoughts on improving developer experience?
Sarah: We should probably use pnpm instead of npm.
Priya: In my opinion, our PR review turnaround time is too slow.
Alex Chen: It might be nice to have automated preview environments someday.
Marcus: Great discussion, let's wrap up with no new action items.

title: Same First Name Ambiguity Test
transcript:
Marcus: We have both Alex Chen and Alex Miller here.
Marcus: Alex, can you update the Datadog dashboard by tomorrow?
Priya: I will review the pull request by tonight.

title: Unassigned Ownership Test
transcript:
Marcus: The staging SSL certificate expires on Sunday.
Marcus: Someone needs to renew the SSL certificate by Friday.
Sarah: I will take the lead on alerting setup today.

title: Friday Late Night Timezone Boundary
transcript:
Sarah: It's late Friday night.
Sarah: I will run the staging database vacuum tomorrow.
Alex Chen: I'll verify the backup restore by next Monday.

title: Crosstalk & Interruption Resolution
transcript:
Alex Chen: I was thinking about the websocket connection...
Priya: Wait Alex, before that, can you fix the broken staging build?
Alex Chen: Yeah, I'll fix the broken staging build today.
Priya: Thanks, and I will publish the release notes tomorrow.

title: Security Vulnerability Triage
transcript:
Sarah: Snyk reported a high severity CVE in our xml parsing dependency.
Sarah: I will patch the xml2js library and deploy to production tomorrow.
Marcus: Should we audit all npm packages?
Alex Chen: I'll audit our top 10 external dependencies by Friday.

title: Frontend Design System Sync
transcript:
Elena: The typography scale is finalized in Figma.
Elena: I will export the design tokens to JSON by tomorrow.
Priya: I'll integrate the new tokens into Tailwind config by Friday.
Marcus: It might be cool to create a public styleguide site later.

title: Billing Webhook Retries
transcript:
Marcus: Stripe webhooks failed for 3 enterprise subscriptions.
Alex Chen: I'll implement an exponential backoff retry queue by tomorrow.
Sarah: I will add dead-letter queue metrics in CloudWatch by Friday.

title: Mobile App Release 2.4
transcript:
Priya: Apple App Store rejected version 2.4 for missing privacy manifest.
Priya: I will generate the Apple privacy manifest file today.
Marcus: When can we submit to Google Play?
Priya: I'll submit the Android bundle by Thursday.

title: Customer Support Escalation
transcript:
Marcus: VIP customer Omega Corp can't invite new team members.
Alex Chen: I'll debug the organization member invite permission check today.
Elena: I'll review the invite modal error states by tomorrow.

title: API Rate Limiting & Quota
transcript:
Sarah: Public API usage spiked 400% from web scrapers.
Sarah: I will deploy Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter by tomorrow.
Alex Chen: I'll notify impacted API key owners by Friday.

title: Performance Optimization & LCP
transcript:
Priya: Google Lighthouse score dropped to 62 on marketing home.
Priya: I will compress hero WebP assets and defer third-party scripts by Friday.
Elena: I'll provide optimized SVG illustrations tomorrow.

title: GDPR Compliance Request
transcript:
Marcus: A European customer filed an Article 17 right to erasure request.
Alex Chen: I will write a script to scrub user personal data from database tables by Friday.
Sarah: I'll verify the data is purged from S3 backup archives by next Monday.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Optimization
transcript:
Sarah: GitHub Actions workflow takes 28 minutes to run.
Sarah: I will enable Docker build caching and parallelize unit tests by Thursday.
Marcus: It would be nice if builds were under 5 minutes.

title: Search Query Latency
transcript:
Alex Chen: Full-text search queries are hitting sequential scans.
Alex Chen: I'll add a GIN index on the documents tsvector column tomorrow.
Priya: I will add debouncing to the search input on the frontend today.

title: Email Deliverability & DMARC
transcript:
Sarah: Mailgun reported DKIM alignment failures for new workspace invites.
Sarah: I will update the DNS DMARC and DKIM records today.
Marcus: Make sure Priya checks the invite email copy.
Priya: I'll review the invite email text by tomorrow.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
transcript:
Alex Chen: PgBouncer ran out of server connections during morning traffic.
Alex Chen: I will tune max_client_conn and pool_size in pgbouncer.ini today.
Sarah: I'll set up automated alerts for pool queue depth by tomorrow.

title: Dark Mode Support
transcript:
Elena: Users have been requesting dark mode.
Elena: I will prepare the dark mode color tokens in Figma by Friday.
Priya: I'll add the Tailwind dark: classes to common components next week.
Marcus: Dark mode is going to look awesome.
negative_phrases: Dark mode is going to look awesome

title: GraphQL N+1 Query Fix
transcript:
Alex Chen: The project tasks query executes 150 SQL queries for 10 users.
Alex Chen: I will batch user loader lookups using DataLoader by tomorrow.
Marcus: Good catch.

title: Staging Environment Reset
transcript:
Sarah: Staging database is polluted with test seed data.
Sarah: I will write an automated nightly database sanitization script by Thursday.
Marcus: That will save everyone time.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
transcript:
Marcus: Enterprise clients require TOTP MFA for admin accounts.
Alex Chen: I will implement the TOTP QR code generator endpoint by Friday.
Priya: I'll build the MFA verification screen in the web app next week.

title: Customer Onboarding Survey
transcript:
Elena: We want to collect feedback on user role selection.
Elena: I will design the 2-question modal in Figma by tomorrow.
Priya: I will trigger the modal after user sign-in by Friday.

title: Data Warehouse Export
transcript:
Marcus: The analytics team needs daily event dumps in Snowflake.
Sarah: I will set up an Airbyte sync pipeline to S3 by Friday.
Alex Chen: I'll verify the JSON schema format tomorrow.

title: Frontend Accessibility (a11y)
transcript:
Priya: Screen readers fail to announce form validation errors.
Priya: I will add aria-live and aria-describedby attributes to all form fields by Thursday.
Elena: I'll verify contrast ratios on disabled buttons tomorrow.

title: Slack Integration Webhook
transcript:
Marcus: Customers want incident alerts posted directly to their Slack channels.
Alex Chen: I will build the Slack incoming webhook dispatch service by Friday.
Priya: I'll add the Slack webhook configuration URL field in project settings next week.

title: Roadmap Wrap-up with Speculation
transcript:
Marcus: Great quarter everyone.
Marcus: We should probably consider expanding into European data centers next year.
Alex Chen: Maybe we should also rewrite our backend in Go.
Sarah: I will produce the infrastructure cost breakdown report by Friday.
Priya: And I'll fix the checkout modal crash today.
negative_phrases: expanding into European data centers next year
